lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>{{damage_trait}}<c> that, when it reduces the <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> of
any of the {{opponent}}'s <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> to 0 and <c:ffff00>destroys<c> it,
deals the leftover <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> as additional {{damage}} to
the <c:ffff00>head<c> {{part}}.

It isn't compatible with the <c:ffff00>All {{part|pl|cap}}<c> {{damage_trait}}.
